Role type: Maximum Term Part-Time (20hrs-week) until January 2027

Role grade: Administration Officer Level 3, (Year1-2)

Department and location: Homeless Health Service, St Vincent's Hospital, Darlinghurst

Salary: $71,072.43 - $73,287.41 (pro-rata) + super + salary packaging 

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services. 

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs. 

About the role

Be the operational backbone of a busy service by providing high-quality administrative support to Nursing, Medical and Allied Health teams, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the unit.

Take ownership of workforce and payroll administration, including rostering, leave management, recruitment coordination, staff records, performance review administration and maintaining compliance documentation.

Drive quality and continuous improvement by supporting audits, accreditation activities, incident management, research projects and reporting that contribute to exceptional patient care.

Coordinate essential business operations through meeting administration, minute taking, equipment and supply management, finance reporting and maintaining accurate data across multiple hospital systems.

Join a collaborative multidisciplinary team where you'll build strong relationships across Mental Health, Homeless Health and Alcohol & Drug Services while providing flexible administrative support across the service.

About you

You have exceptional customer service skills and are passionate about delivering a professional, compassionate experience for patients, carers and colleagues.

You are confident using Microsoft Office and a range of electronic systems, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

You are an excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills, building positive relationships and handling enquiries professionally both in person and over the phone.

You thrive in a fast-paced healthcare environment, with outstanding organisational, time management and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities as part of a collaborative team.

You demonstrate empathy, resilience and professionalism when supporting patients with diverse and complex needs and are committed to continuous learning and professional development.

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a government salary sacrifice program. Make a proportion of your salary tax-free

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

About the hospital

In this role you will be based at St Vincent's hospital, Darlinghurst. 

A busy inner-city hospital in a beautiful location

Surrounded by great cafes, galleries and theatres, parks, nightlife, and nearby glorious beaches

A place of expert clinical care for at-risk people

Closely partnered with universities & affiliated research institutes, many of which are located on-campus

Centres of excellence include heart & lung transplantation, bone marrow transplantation, cardiology, cancer care, AIDS-HIV, respiratory medicine, mental health, homeless health, drug & alcohol services, and correctional health 

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

As part of our commitment to reconciliation we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in delivering care that heals body, mind, spirit and community.

Environmental Officer
Join the Tibaldi team as a full-time Environmental Officer based in Clayton Victoria.
Our Story
Founded in 1934, the Tibaldi family of butchers had a dream to provide Australian’s with only the finest cuts of meats processed the traditional way using authentic Italian recipes.
90 years later not much has changed. Today, Tibaldi is a major supplier to the retail, route and food service industry across Australia. The company’s state of the art facilities in Clayton excels industry standards using leading technology.
The product range spans across traditional Italian salami, ham, bacon, traditional smallgoods, fresh meat including a range of Outdoor Bred pork. 

That’s Tradition. That’s Tibaldi.

•	Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including waste, water, energy, emissions, noise, and biodiversity assessments.

•	Ensure compliance with applicable Commonwealth, State and Local Government environmental legislation, regulations, licences and permits
•	Monitor environmental obligations and maintain compliance registers. 
•	Assist with environmental audits and inspections. 
•	Support regulatory reporting requirements and permit applications.

Our Ways of Working

Job description:

 
Assist the Manager Medical Orderly and Security Services and Nurse Unit Manager (NUM) - Emergency Department (ED) in ensuring a safe and secure environment within the ED.
Act as a member of the Code Black Team in ED and conduct internal hospital security functions as directed.
Provide manual handling assistance with patient care requirements when and as directed.

 

 






 

The Team

The Launceston General Hospital (LGH) Emergency Department is the primary provider of emergency care for Northern Tasmania, delivering comprehensive 24-hour services for patients presenting with conditions ranging from minor injuries to life-threatening emergencies.

As part of Hospitals North, the department works collaboratively with Ambulance Tasmania, inpatient teams and community-based services to ensure safe, efficient and patient-focused care. Committed to excellence, the team fosters a culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement to meet the evolving healthcare needs of the Tasmanian community.

The Role

Support the delivery of a safe and secure Emergency Department by assisting the multidisciplinary care team, participating in security responses (including Code Black), and providing manual handling support to meet patient care needs.

You will need:

Capacity to prioritise tasks and work effectively in a busy environment

Strong ability to collaborate and contribute positively as part of a team

Demonstrated reliability, flexibility and a strong work ethic

Please refer to Statement of Duties for full list of duties, key accountabilities and responsibilities.

Details of appointment

Multiple permanent, full- and part-time positions available working up to 76 hours per fortnight commencing as soon as possible

*Note: Notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies

Salary

$70,033 to $75,114 per annum + 12% superannuation + access to salary packaging.

You'll have access to salary package a range of benefits including living expenses up to $9,010 + $2,650 in meal entertainment each FBT year + other benefits if eligible.

Benefits available to eligible candidates 

Professional development and accelerated pathways.

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

Eligibility

result.description:
We are a growing Australian business group operating across wholesale distribution, event services and education. As our organisation continues to expand and diversify, we are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative and operational functions and support the continued growth of the business.

This is a senior, hands-on role suited to a proactive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading office operations, developing efficient business systems, coordinating multiple business functions, and supporting strategic initiatives that drive organisational growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day office operations across multiple business divisions.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve office procedures, administrative systems and operational workflows.
- Coordinate communication and workflow across departments to ensure efficient and effective business operations.
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement initiatives that increase efficiency, streamline processes and support sustainable business growth.
- Lead the implementation, optimisation and integration of enterprise business systems, digital workflow platforms and business automation technologies.
- Coordinate supplier relationships, purchasing activities and operational logistics.
- Prepare management reports, operational documentation and business performance information to support informed decision-making.
- Assist with budgeting, resource planning and business administration.
- Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, staff administration and HR documentation.
- Maintain company policies, compliance records and organisational documentation.
- Support directors in delivering strategic projects, organisational change initiatives and business expansion activities.
- Establish scalable administrative systems and operational processes to support future growth.

Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

- A minimum of three years' experience in an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Business Operations or similar management role.
- Demonstrated experience managing office operations within a growing, multi-site or multi-faceted business environment.
- Proven experience implementing or improving enterprise business systems, ERP, CRM or other integrated business management platforms.
- Experience leading business process improvement, workflow optimisation and automation initiatives.
- Strong organisational, project coordination and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Experience developing and maintaining business policies, procedures and operational documentation.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
- High-level computer literacy, including Microsoft 365 and cloud-based business applications.
- Experience with bookkeeping processes, reporting and business administration.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you will play a key role in strengthening business operations, implementing scalable systems and supporting the continued growth of multiple business divisions.

If you are an experienced Office Manager looking for a challenging and rewarding role where you can make a genuine impact, we encourage you to apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Program Support Officer-Community Nursing



 Apply now
 Job no: 934380

 Work type: Part time

 Location: Kangaroo Island

 Categories: Administration, Business and Management





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network

Kangaroo Island

Salary: ASO2 $66,442 - $69,504 per annum (adjusted to hours worked)

Permanent-Ongoing

Part Time (0.1 FTE - 1 day per fortnight)

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING?

We're offering an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and dedicated team within the Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network. This role provides a dynamic and rewarding work environment where you'll play an important part in supporting healthcare services across the region. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, opportunities for professional growth, and the satisfaction of contributing to quality care within your community.

WHO ARE WE?

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas (position based in Kangaroo Island). We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve.

WHERE AND HOW YOU WILL WORK

Kingscote is the largest town on Kangaroo Island, offering a close-knit community, stunning coastal landscapes, and a relaxed island lifestyle. With essential services, local amenities, and abundant recreational opportunities, it's ideal for professionals seeking a unique work-life balance in a scenic and welcoming environment. Its vibrant local healthcare, education, and tourism sectors provide rewarding career opportunities while living in this picturesque setting. For more information Discover Kingscote

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We're seeking a motivated and reliable Program Support Officer - Community Nursing to join our Country Health Connect team within the Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network. You will be an organised and proactive professional who enjoys supporting teams in a busy healthcare environment.

You will bring:

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong customer service focus with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.

Sound computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and data entry systems.

Effective time management skills and the ability to prioritise competing tasks.

A collaborative and flexible approach to working as part of a team.

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on...

HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE?

As an integral member of our administration team, you will:

Deliver high-quality front-line customer service, including responding to enquiries, managing reception services, directing visitors, booking appointments-resources, and relaying accurate messages.

Provide comprehensive administrative and clerical support to staff, the Business Services Coordinator, and Program Manager, including invoicing, stationery ordering, and general office duties.

Maintain accurate electronic and hardcopy records, including data entry and management in the Client Management Engine (CME), in line with retention and disposal requirements.

Support business operations through IT assistance-help desk support, collaboration with administrative colleagues, and flexibility to work across locations and functions as required.

Contribute to continuous improvement through collaboration, input into policies and operational planning, and support for accreditation and change initiatives.

 Ensure corporate compliance by adhering to SA Health policies, ethical standards, WHS, EEO principles, cultural awareness, professional development, and disaster preparedness activities.

WHAT WILL WE OFFER YOU IN RETURN?

At BHFLHN, not only will you be working in an environment surrounded by beautiful scenery and nature we see your work here as not just as a job, but an opportunity to extend, progress or consolidate your career with us. We therefore offer you opportunities to be supported in the following ways:

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. Click here for details and contact the enquires person for further information.

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information

Access to generous leave provisions and professional development opportunities

Support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program available to BHFLHN staff and their families. 

WHAT ELSE DO YOU NEED TO KNOW-WHAT IS ESSENTIAL FOR SUCCESS?

Working in this environment, it is important to us that we only employ people with the upmost integrity and commitment to serving the South Australian community and its visitors to the highest possible standards. To ensure that we meet that commitment there are a few checks that you will be required to undertake. These are detailed on the Role Description, and do vary depending on what is required in the role, but are likely to include the following:

You will need to be immunised. The policy on immunisation is very detailed, so please contact the Enquiries Person for this position if you have any queries. Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy

You will need to undergo employment screening, what you require is also on the front page of the Role Description.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

BHFLHN is an Equal Opportunities employer committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, disability, all genders, and LGBTQI+ community.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

BHFLHN is an Equal Opportunities employer committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, disability, all genders, and LGBTQI+ community.

NEED TO RELOCATE?

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. See what is available here: Relocation support | SA Health. Find out more about working in the Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network
